Pluto Makes Mars Pause for the Hidden Detail

Your Mercury notices the small signals: scent, tone, footsteps, sequence. With the North Node beside it, that noticing can become a social skill. You can inspect the world and still return to the group. Let one gentle cue be your bridge from private investigation to a choice made with us.
Ella, you pick up the hidden details of a room. When your person gives that noticing a clear next move, you can show just how beautifully your attention works.
